name: Falcon 9 Block 5 | NROL-186
description: Second batch of satellites for a reconnaissance satellite constellation built by SpaceX and Northrop Grumman for the National Reconnaissance Office to provide imaging and other reconnaissance capabilities.

landing.description: The Falcon 9 first stage B1081 has landed on ASDS OCISLY after its 8th flight.
